events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. Still influencing music and culture decades on, what's your go-to track from The King?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic passing of influential hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years ago this week, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his unparalleled impact on hip-hop culture. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the extraordinary Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work redefined rock music forever. What's the one riff that instantly makes you think of Jimi?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking strong. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise? As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in 1975, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does this powerful track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Remember The iPod
angles.copy: 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did your first iPod hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 movie or moment? License to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incredible life and music of John Lennon. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Memories
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. So much music, so many different sounds. Which track from this epic double album stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, on the anniversary of his death in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: It's 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy... truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album in their journey. What's your go-to track from this classic?
